WM DSGVO Art. 17 Cryptographic Privacy E: WM GDPR Art. 17 Cryptographic Privacy Eraser
Löschanträge nach Art. 17 DSGVO mit Best: GDPR Art. 17 erasure requests confirmed via a link sent to the address; thereafter comments are anonymised, the user account (except administrators) is deleted and WooCommerce billing fields are optionally anonymised. Each erasure receives an HMAC-chained record. No legal assessment of the request.
Löschanträge mit Bestätigungslink, Lösch: Erasure requests with a confirmation link, deletion or anonymisation of the data WordPress itself holds for an email address, and a chained record per erasure. Does not replace a legal review of the request.

Jeder Nachweis speichert statt der Adres: Each record stores a keyed hash instead of the address, the count of entries per area and a seal binding the preceding record. Edited, inserted, reordered or deleted records fail verification while the chain-tip option remains unchanged; anyone with database write access can alter that option, and anyone holding wp-config.php can re-seal the chain.
Beide Schalter sind standardmäßig ausges: Both switches are off by default so neither tax-relevant billing data nor erasure records are removed unintentionally.
Überschreibt Vor- und Nachname, erste Ad: Overwrites first name, last name, first address line, phone and email on WooCommerce orders for the address. Enable only after checking statutory retention periods (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB).

Wenn aktiviert, entfernt die Deinstallat: When enabled, uninstalling permanently removes all plugin options and drops the requests and erasure records tables. By default, records and options are kept.
Kommentare mit dieser Adresse: Name, Adr: Comments with this address: name, address, URL, IP, user agent and user association are overwritten, and the text is replaced with “[Content deleted on request under Art. 17 GDPR]”. The comments themselves remain.
Benutzerkonto mit dieser Adresse: wird m: User account with this address: deleted via wp_delete_user(), including posts authored by that account. Administrator accounts are never deleted and the record notes this. On Multisite, wp_delete_user() removes the account only from this site and records removed_from_this_site.
WooCommerce-Bestellungen: nur wenn die O: WooCommerce orders: only when wm_dsgvo_anonymize_wc_orders is on, overwriting billing first and last name, first address line, email and phone through WooCommerce order objects (HPOS and post storage). Off by default because billing data may be subject to statutory retention (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB); the plugin does not decide which applies.
Nicht erfasst: Tabellen anderer Plugins: Not covered: tables of other plugins (forms, newsletters, bookings), user meta of retained accounts, comment meta, shipping addresses, files, logs, caches and backups. WordPress core privacy erasers are not invoked.
Ob ein Antrag berechtigt ist, ob Ausnahm: Whether a request is justified, whether Art. 17(3) GDPR exceptions apply and which retention period governs is not decided by the plugin.
